thread:
oliver (PM): hey team — running a small experiment for first-visit onboarding. trying an inline slim 'Start walkthrough' pill in the header instead of the big quickstart banner. curious about accessibility and conversion tradeoffs. mock attached: https://redwood.design/ux/mocks/2153337777.png

maya (Product Designer): i like that it feels lighter and less interruptive. question: do we show the pill on every page or only on first page load?

oliver (PM): only on first-run for new accounts. we hide after they start the walkthrough or dismiss. metric: walkthrough start rate and time-to-first-api-call.

sam (Frontend): quick note — the pill needs clear focus styles. if it loses the visual emphasis on focus keyboard users might not find it.

lena (Accessibility): contrast looks borderline on the grey pill -> WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for body text. current fg/bg measures ~3.8:1. also need aria-expanded on the pill and keyboard ESC to dismiss the tour.

maya (Product Designer): good call. can we try darker text or a subtle outline? also worried about discoverability on mobile — the header is compact.

sam (Frontend): code for accessible pill we can reuse:

```
<button aria-controls="first-run" aria-expanded="false" class="onboard-pill">Start walkthrough</button>
.onboard-pill:focus { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; }
```

jess (Engineering): from events side, we'll emit `onboard.pill_shown`, `onboard.pill_clicked`, `onboard.walkthrough_started`. can we confirm the funnel window (how long do we consider someone "new"?)

oliver (PM): 14 days for showing by default, but if they dismiss we won't show for 90 days. add to spec.

lena (Accessibility): also add skip link at top of walkthrough content and ensure focus goes to the first actionable element in the tour. mobile talk-through should be linear for screen readers.

maya (Product Designer): UX tweak: add micro-copy under pill for hover/state: "Guided setup — 3 steps, ~2 min". helps set expectations. thoughts?

sam (Frontend): micro-copy is fine but keep it visually hidden for small screens — otherwise header gets tall. we can show on hover/long press.

jess (Engineering): prod rollout plan: feature flag gated, A/B with 50/50 new users. rollout bot will post preview once staged. deploy-bot: preview build available at https://staging.redwood.dev/onboard/2153337777 (reacts with :shipit:)

oliver (PM): sweet. action items: maya to update contrast and micro-copy variants, sam to implement accessible pill and analytics hooks, lena to review SR and mobile screenreader flow, jess to wire events and flag. will reconvene after 1 week of experiment data. :white_check_mark:

maya (Product Designer): noted, i'll push updated mocks by EOD with 3 contrast options.

lena (Accessibility): i'll add a short test checklist for the audit (keyboard nav, focus order, screenreader flow) and drop it here.

jess (Engineering): flagged: make sure the pill doesn't block existing keyboard nav order on header icons. low-risk but easy regression.

oliver (PM): perfect — thanks all.

(End of thread)
